name: music-room
description: Same commands as the Makefile, for environments without make (Windows)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix mobile ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && cd mobile && npx expo lint
scripts.e2e: npm --prefix e2e ci && cd e2e && npx playwright install chromium && npm run checks:ui
scripts.e2e:cli: npm --prefix e2e ci && cd e2e && npx playwright install chromium && npm run checks
